name: E01-archive-sample
note: PIP's file on the case: first ~4:52 of Episode 1 (cold open, title, scenes 1-5) in the archive format. Built by arch/build.py.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Captain. The bank has taken the left engine.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Which one's the left?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The one that has stopped.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: And the navigation lights. And the heating. And the coffee machine.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: They can't take the coffee machine.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: It was financed separately.

lines.speaker: TEMI
lines.text: Good morning! This is Temi in Recoveries. Your vessel is being recovered.

lines.speaker: TEMI
lines.text: Full recovery, including the air, at six tonight, lunar time. Please remain seated while—

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Temi! Hi! I'm about to make a payment—

lines.speaker: TEMI
lines.text: —we disable your—

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: A big one. Enormous—

lines.speaker: TEMI
lines.text: Hello! You're speaking to Temi in Recoveries!

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Why does she keep doing that?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: She is in Lagos. You are arguing with the past.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: And I'm winning.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A job, posted to us directly. One parcel, sealed, prepaid. Shackleton crater, by six tonight. The fee is—

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Is?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Exactly what we owe. To the cent.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Take it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: You have not read the—

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Take it take it take it take it—

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Accepted. I am also filing a report on you. Once is binding.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Who sends a parcel to a crater?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Someone who knew precisely how much we owed.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Lucky.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Filed under "arithmetic".

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: Eleven.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: That's a nine.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: It's a nine that believes in itself.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: Eight months, Jax. Eight months unpaid is called volunteering.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Today. Off the top. Before fuel, before food, before me.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: Before you?

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Before me.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: Say it to Pip. So it's on record.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Recorded. I have filed it with the one from March, and the one from May. May's was louder.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: It's warm.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Twenty-one degrees. According to its stamps, it has been twenty-one degrees for twenty years.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: Something in here is alive. Or very well wrapped.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Shackleton crater. Eleven minutes. We will be four hours early. I have never been early.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Enjoy it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Captain.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Typo.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: "The Silver Hat." I'd go there.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: "The." We can work with "The".

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I am afraid "The" is not an address.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: It's a crater, Pip. Craters don't leave.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The crater is still there, Captain. It has merely stopped being anywhere.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Did we do that?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: We are not that important.

lines.speaker: MAMANI
lines.text: Unscheduled, Rim Port control. Your destination was withdrawn from the Atlas at fourteen-oh-two.

lines.speaker: MAMANI
lines.text: All goods for it are held by customs. Land at bay nine.

lines.speaker: MAMANI
lines.text: Do not open your hold. Your client is nowhere, Captain. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I am filing a report on the Atlas. Withdrawn without notice to the carrier.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Who reads those?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: That is not the point of them.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Next.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: There's no one else here.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: It's procedure. Next.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Parcel, one. Sealed. Addressed to a district withdrawn at fourteen-oh-two. Seized at fourteen-nineteen.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Here's my situation. My aunt—

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: You don't have an aunt.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: You don't know that.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Your form says next of kin: none.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: She's very distant. Look — I can tell you're someone who appreciates flexibility.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: I'm a cartographer. I appreciate where things actually are.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Then you'll appreciate the Lunar Courier Exemption. Section twelve.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: There are nine sections.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Which is why twelve is so exclusive.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Is there anything true you'd like to tell me, Captain? Before I stamp it.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: I'm very good at my job.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: You're four hours from losing your ship.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: I'm good at it in bursts.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Your record starts seven years ago.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Late bloomer.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Your record isn't late, Captain. It's blank.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Is that a problem?

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Not for customs.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Can I at least see it?

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Holding bay.

lines.speaker: BARON
lines.text: I used to be taller!

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Which owner?

lines.speaker: NOAKES
lines.text: Doctor Sen. We discussed the notebook.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: We discussed it being on my desk. It's in my hand.

lines.speaker: NOAKES
lines.text: You were struck off for saying the map was wrong. Please don't get struck off again for saying it louder.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: It is wrong.

lines.speaker: NOAKES
lines.text: It's official. Those aren't opposites, Doctor Sen. They're departments.

lines.speaker: NOAKES
lines.text: One more complaint and your probation ends. Let nothing happen. One more day.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: I'll be quiet.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: Is it the box? Tell me it's not the box.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: It's not the box.

lines.speaker: LUCIA
lines.text: It's the box.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: She has hung up. Captain, there is a man next to you.

lines.speaker: CHICHIKOV
lines.text: Please. Don't stop on my account.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: How long have you been there?

lines.speaker: CHICHIKOV
lines.text: Long enough to be sorry about your parcel. A hundred and eighty-two thousand, isn't it?

lines.speaker: CHICHIKOV
lines.text: The lien on The Unscheduled. And Miss Ortega — eight months. That's a long time to be loyal.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: CHICHIKOV
lines.text: A buyer. I buy what the register has forgotten, Captain. You would be amazed how much of it still works.

lines.speaker: CHICHIKOV
lines.text: If your parcel should become available.

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Chich... Chicha...

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: Pip. Did you get a look at him?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I have logged him as "man, average".

lines.speaker: JAX
lines.text: What did he look like?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Average.
